summary.plain: UA2's own sighting of the W boson: four isolated high-energy electron events with an invisible partner particle carrying away momentum, confirming UA1's result independently.
summary.technical: UA2 Collaboration, Phys. Lett. B 122 (1983) 476-485; four candidate events with a single isolated high-p_T electron and missing transverse energy, consistent with p-pbar -> W(+/-) + anything, W -> e + nu. UA2 physicist Luigi Di Lella announced the result at a CERN seminar on 22 January 1983, three days before the joint public announcement.

title: Observation of Single Isolated Electrons of High Transverse Momentum in Events with Missing Transverse Energy at the CERN anti-p p Collider
why_it_matters: An independent confirmation of the W boson using a very different detector design (calorimetry rather than a magnetic spectrometer), establishing the discovery beyond a single experiment's systematics.
